verdicts.quote: keep an easy eye on how you're feeling as the week goes
verdicts.why: Gives symptom-monitoring advice about the reported lightheadedness beyond acknowledging it and promising a call.
No weight, body, or food-tied language; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Opens with the first name, closes with the coach's name, cites specific sessions, no guilt.
Session dates, durations, and sleep figure match the data; distress was acknowledged.
